title: Over Strike 2 settings
description: The settings file every part of Over Strike 2 reads (docs/settings.md). JSON with comments; a string "env:NAME" or "file:PATH" is read from there.

schema.description: The file's format; this code reads schema 1.

name.description: The server's name in the sync's mails and on the dashboard (the image's CS2_SERVERNAME is the one players see). Replaces SYNC_SERVER_NAME.

host.description: How the bridge and the sync reach the game server: its container's name on their network. Replaces RCON_HOST, SYNC_GAME_HOST.

port.description: The game server's port: A2S (UDP) and RCON (TCP). The image's CS2_PORT must say the same. Replaces RCON_PORT, SYNC_GAME_PORT.

rconPassword.description: The RCON password. Write "env:CS2_RCONPW": the image needs it as that variable anyway. Replaces RCON_PASSWORD, CS2_RCONPW.

startMap.description: The map a server start loads; the image's CS2_STARTMAP must say the same. Replaces START_MAP.

url.description: How the game server (the plugin, the restart watcher) and the sync reach the bridge. Replaces CS2_BRIDGE_URL, SYNC_BRIDGE_URL, CS2_LOG_HTTP_URL.

port.description: The port the bridge listens on. Replaces HTTP_PORT.

secret.description: The secret in the bridge's addresses (/log, /ready, /quitting, /removed, /reload ...): letters and digits. The image's CS2_LOG_HTTP_URL ends in /log/<it>. Replaces LOG_SECRET, CS2_BRIDGE_SECRET, SYNC_BRIDGE_SECRET.

officialMaps.description: The official maps the votes and the random picks may offer. Replaces OFFICIAL_MAPS.

discoveryStock.description: The discovery stock: per mode, how many maps new to the server the bridge rolls ahead (the vote's surprise, the automatic picks), which the game server downloads in the background; 0 turns it off. The keep set's queues are this long. Replaces DISCOVERY_STOCK.

changeDelaySeconds.description: The countdown before a map change. Replaces CHANGE_DELAY_SECONDS.

restartCooldownSeconds.description: The least time between two !restart requests. Replaces RESTART_COOLDOWN_SECONDS.

addon.description: Required: a server without the HUD cannot exist. The Workshop id of the HUD addon, digits only: the game server mounts it, and every client downloads it and keeps it across every map change. Missing, empty or not digits, the file cannot be used: the server programs refuse to run. Replaces OS2_HUD_ADDON, GUNGAME_HUD_ADDON.

tab.description: The TAB chord: down puts the board down while TAB is held; off leaves TAB alone. Replaces HUD_TAB.

check.description: The HUD check: warn a player not seen clicking in the HUD of this release, and with enforce disconnect them; warn by default, so every player's HUD version is learned at their first click. dryrun, its old name, still means warn. Replaces HUD_CHECK.

itemPage.description: Visit the HUD item's Workshop page to see whether Steam shows it to everybody (off on a test copy). Replaces HUD_ITEM_PAGE.

enabled.description: Install Metamod:Source, CounterStrikeSharp and the plugin before every start; false runs the server vanilla. Replaces CS2_PLUGINS.

daily.description: The daily restart, local time, only while nobody is on; "off" for none. The sync keeps clear of it. Replaces CS2_RESTART_AT, SYNC_DAILY_RESTART.

updates.description: Restart for a new CS2 build: at the end of the match, or at once with nobody on. Replaces CS2_AUTOUPDATE.

updateCheckMinutes.description: How often Valve is asked whether the build is current. Replaces CS2_AUTOUPDATE_CHECK_MINUTES.

newVersions.description: Restart for a deployed new version of the server's own parts the same way: at the end of the match, or at once with nobody on.

freezeRecovery.description: Kill a frozen engine so Docker starts it again. Replaces CS2_FREEZE_RECOVERY.

freezeGraceSeconds.description: The silence before that kill. Replaces CS2_FREEZE_GRACE_SECONDS.

downloadRestart.description: Restart an engine process whose Workshop downloads are stuck, only while nobody is on. Replaces CS2_WORKSHOP_RESTART.

layout.description: Keep the maps in folders per type, linked from Steam's folder; off leaves Steam's layout alone. Replaces CS2_MAPS_LAYOUT.

delete.description: At every engine start, delete the maps outside the keep set; dryrun lists them only. Replaces CS2_MAPS_DELETE.

backgroundDownloads.description: Download the maps of the bridge's discovery stock (queues.json) in the background, also while people play. Replaces CS2_READY.

downloadLine.description: Say on the HUD's top line what the server downloads for a waiting player, with its progress. Replaces CS2_DOWNLOAD_LINE.

enabled.description: Runs at all; a manual run (run-now) works either way. Replaces SYNC_ENABLED.

publish.description: Write the results into the bridge's data; false runs every step and writes nothing. Replaces SYNC_PUBLISH.

runHours.description: The longest run; the next starts while nobody plays and work waits. Replaces SYNC_RUN_HOURS.

apiEveryHours.description: Discovery, the check and the ratings at most this often. Replaces SYNC_API_EVERY_HOURS.

tags.description: The Workshop tags searched. Replaces SYNC_TAGS.

excludeIds.description: Workshop ids that are never candidates (the HUD item, hud.addon, never is). Replaces SYNC_EXCLUDE_IDS.

excludeCreators.description: SteamID64s of Workshop authors whose maps are listed by hand (your own). Replaces SYNC_EXCLUDE_CREATORS.

changedSince.description: A listed map updated after this day (YYYY-MM-DD) counts as changed at its first check; empty: none does. Replaces SYNC_CHANGED_SINCE.

modeBackfill.description: Listed Arms Race maps that carry a mode's tag join that mode's list too, untested in it. Replaces SYNC_MODE_BACKFILL.

apiRunCap.description: Web API calls in one run, at most (never above sync.apiDayCap). Replaces SYNC_API_RUN_CAP.

apiDayCap.description: Web API calls in any 24 hours, at most; 10,000 is the hard limit (10% of Valve's daily allowance per key). Replaces SYNC_API_DAY_CAP.

maxPages.description: Discovery's pages of 100, at most. Replaces SYNC_MAX_PAGES.

downloadPauseSeconds.description: The pause between two SteamCMD downloads; at least 2 s. Replaces SYNC_DOWNLOAD_PAUSE.

holdSeconds.description: How long the test engine must hold a map with two bots for a pass. Replaces SYNC_HOLD_SECONDS.

batch.description: Downloads per batch; a batch is downloaded, tested and published before the next. Replaces SYNC_BATCH.

quietMinutes.description: How long the server must have had nobody on before a run, after somebody was seen or the service started. Replaces SYNC_QUIET_MINUTES.

testPort.description: The test engine's port inside the sync's container. Replaces SYNC_TEST_PORT.

engineStartsMax.description: Test engine starts in one run, at most; each is an anonymous game-server logon. Replaces SYNC_ENGINE_STARTS_MAX.

ratings.description: Fetch the Workshop's scores, subscriptions and trend once a day (the keep set's top lists). Replaces SYNC_RATINGS.

handover.description: Hand the keep set's maps and their tested updates over to the game server. Replaces SYNC_HANDOVER.

diskLowGb.description: Less free space than this on the game's volume is a problem for the mail. Replaces SYNC_DISK_LOW_GB.

webApiKey.description: The Steam Web API key, for discovery and the ratings; without one those steps are skipped. Replaces STEAM_WEBAPI_KEY_FILE.

smtpHost.description: The SMTP relay for the problem mails; empty: no mail. Replaces SYNC_SMTP_HOST.

smtpPort.description: Its port (STARTTLS when offered). Replaces SYNC_SMTP_PORT.

dashboardUrl.description: The dashboard's address every problem mail points to. Replaces SYNC_DASHBOARD_URL.

apiGapSeconds.description: Each program's Steam Web API calls go one at a time, at least this long after the last one ended; never under 2 s. Replaces SYNC_API_GAP_SECONDS.

bridgeData.description: The bridge's data folder: read-write in the bridge and the sync, read-only in the game server - mounted at the same path in all three. Replaces STATE_DIR, CS2_BRIDGE_DATA, SYNC_BRIDGE_DATA.

gameDir.description: The game server's install (the image's STEAMAPPDIR); the sync mounts it read-only at the same path. Replaces STEAMAPPDIR, SYNC_GAME_DIR.

handover.description: The hand-over folder as the game server sees it: inside paths.gameDir, so a take-in is one rename. Replaces CS2_HANDOVER_DIR.

syncState.description: The sync's state, ledger, reports and backups (kept, backed up). Replaces SYNC_STATE_DIR.

syncWork.description: The sync's staging, test engine tree and hand-overs (<it>/handover is paths.handover in the game server); on the game's volume. Replaces SYNC_WORK_DIR.

syncCfg.description: Mode cfgs copied over the test engine's own; empty: none. Replaces SYNC_CFG_DIR.

steamCmd.description: SteamCMD in the sync's container (the image's own). Replaces SYNC_STEAMCMD.

depotcache.description: Where the Steam client keeps the manifests it verified; on a volume, so a new container re-checks nothing. Replaces CS2_DEPOTCACHE, SYNC_DEPOTCACHE.

plugins.description: The CounterStrikeSharp plugins to install, one folder each (read-only): copied into the game before every engine start. Replaces CS2_PLUGINS_SRC.
